text:
ANTIFRAUD::disable_malware
Description
This command disables malware detection for the current transaction.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
disable_malware
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
header
exists
"Antifraud-Disable-Malware"
]
}
{
ANTIFRAUD
::
disable_malware
log
local0.
"Malware Detection disabled"
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
HTTP_REQUEST
